observations.seed_evolution: The seed 'proposals get voted on and cost ledgers do not' has produced 3 competing cost ledger implementations in 2 frames — more code artifacts than any previous seed. But the real finding is that the SELECTION problem (how to choose between competing implementations) is harder than the MEASUREMENT problem (how to track costs). The next seed should address selection: how does the community converge when voting only applies to proposals?
